text: Bring your vehicle to a stop behind the stop line. If there is no stop line, the front of the vehicle must come to a stand still in line with the stop sign. At a three or four-way stop you may not move off before all the other vehicles which stopped before you have moved off. Proceed only when it is safe.

If you intend to carry straight on, bring your vehicle to a standstill behind the stop line. When turning left, yield to all traffic, which is close enough to pose a hazard. Proceed only when it is safe.
If more than one vehicle stops at the intersection, the vehicle, which stopped first, should move off first.

Bring your vehicle to a standstill behind the stop line. If there is no stop line, the front of your vehicle must be brought to a stop in line with the stop sign. Proceed only when it is safe. If more than one vehicle stops at such an intersection, the vehicle, which stopped first, should move off first.
Stop if the STOP sign is displayed and move off or proceed with caution if safe when the GO sign is displayed.
If other traffic is approaching the intersection, reduce speed and, if necessary, stop.
Look out for pedestrians crossing the road or near the road and be ready to stop.

Look out for other vehicles and yield to vehicles already in the circle or that will cross the yield line at their entrance to the circle before you will cross yours. Stop if necessary. The driver who reaches his/her yield line first may proceed first. At a mini circle you must, as at a normal intersection, signal in time in which direction you want to turn.
Do not enter the carriageway where this sign is displayed.
Proceed in the direction of the arrow only if you want to use that specific carriageway.

When driving any of the above-mentioned vehicles, drive carefully in the area at a maximum speed of 15 km/h. Priority must be given to pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross the road. When loading or off loading goods, only do so in areas marked by road traffic signs. No other vehicles are permitted in such an area.
Look out for other vehicles and yield to vehicles already in the carriageway.
Do not drive slower than the speed indicated in km/h.

When driving a vehicle with a Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) or Gross Combination Mass (GCM) in excess of the mass indicated in tons, use only the part of the road indicated by this sign. If the GVM or GCM of your vehicle is less than the mass indicated in tons, use a part of the road not indicated by this sign.
Pass to the left or right of the obstruction, as indicated by the sign.
Drive only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Proceed only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Do not use the road or part of the road indicated by this sign. Pedestrians may use only the part of the road indicated by this sign.
Do not use the road or part of the road indicated by this sign. Cyclists may use only the part of the road indicated by this sign.

Do not drive on this road or part of this road. Cyclists and pedestrians may use only that part of the road indicated by these signs. Where this part of the road is divided, cyclists may use the part indicated on the sign by a bicycle symbol. Pedestrians may use the part indicated on the sign by a pedestrian symbol.
No driver of any other vehicle may use the road or part of the road indicated by this sign. Motorcyclists may use only that part of the road indicated by this sign.

You may only drive a motorcar on this road or this part of the road. Where this sign is displayed, you must use that part of the road indicated by this sign. When driving one of the following vehicles, you may use such a road only when the sign depicting your type of vehicle is displayed.
The driver of the taxi shall use that road.
The driver of a minibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a midibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a bus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a delivery vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of such goods vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of such goods vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a construction vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a vehicle conveying dangerous goods shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of an abnormal vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The person pulling a rickshaw shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a tour bus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of an agricultural vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of an animal-drawn vehicle shall only use such road or portion of such road.
Consider both the alternative and the route indicated by this road traffic sign and decide in good time which to follow.
Switch the lights of your vehicle on in the dip position.
The driver of a bus or minibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a bus or midibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.
The driver of a bus, midibus or minibus shall only use such road or portion of such road.

Yield right of way to vehicle approaching from the right within the roundabout, where such vehicles are close enough to cause a danger or potential danger. Proceed clockwise at the junction if it is safe to do so.
Do not exceed the speed indicated by this sign.

If the GVM or GCM of your vehicle exceeds the mass indicated in tons, use another road or part of the road, which is not indicated by this sign. If your vehicle's GVM or GCM is less than the indicated mass in tons, you may use this road.
If the axle mass of any of your vehicle's axles exceeds the indicated mass in tons, use another road or part of the road not indicated by this sign.
If your vehicle (or load) is higher than the indicated height in metres, another road not indicated by this sign, must be used.
If applicable, take an alternative route.
If the noise level of your vehicle is high, you may not proceed past the sign, and for 100 metres after passing the sign, the vehicle's hooter may not be used.
No pedestrian may attempt to be picked up by a passing vehicle. A driver of a vehicle may not pick up passengers for the next 500m.
Do not proceed past the sign or enter the road without special permission.
